title: Adrastus
summary: Adrastus is dated in Raleigh's chronological table (1617), column Sicyon, by a yeere of the World. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person.
description: Added from the Raleigh import (The History of the World, 1617). Raleigh is display-only. He gives a yeere of the World, not a BC year, and no tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: Calculated from printed figures. No tier 1–4 birth, no tier reign start, and no provisional year. Raleigh prints the yeere of the World 2811. Creation is 4032 BC (Kevin, 2026-10-28). BC = 4033 − AM, so AM 2811 = 1222 BC. The figure is not written into year_bc_ad. A printed year for this person would replace it.

reign.note: Year cell "3493 2811 298". The third printed figure 298 is the column "Exodus", not a length. To the Reader (sig. 780b): the Julian Period exceeds the yeere of the World by 682. The 4 at the end of the name is the reign length he prints. The end year is not printed on this row. Column: Sicyon..
